_readme: Invitation lines that accompany a shared question (#186). The shared link already unfurls into a card showing the question, so these lines never repeat it, and they never say what the sharer picked. One pool per category; a random line is used per share. Keep kids-family copy kid-appropriate. 'default' covers an unknown category. Edit text here, no code change needed.
